# scene standard: 2026-10-16.2
def scene(cr, t, u, pts, host):
    """HERO: a tall New York apartment block
    SUBSTANCE: blaring sound waves
    CAUSE: Data shoves a giant loudspeaker up to the block and its noise floods the lower floors
    The apartment block stands for every complaint the city takes: a
    brick New York walk-up with fire escapes and a water tower on the roof,
    on a real street under a far skyline. Shove by shove, Data rolls a
    huge loudspeaker up the sidewalk to the building, and the closer it
    gets the higher its sound waves wash up the facade: pale rings of
    sound rolling over the windows, which light up and blare, until
    exactly the noise share of the floors is drowned in it. The sound
    keeps its own look (rings of air), and only a bracket down the
    building's edge wears the accent, so the cut sits on the building
    itself. Done by 0.62 and held: the speaker keeps blaring and Data
    keeps his hands on it."""
    rows = [(str(l), float(v)) for l, v in pts]
    tot = sum(v for _, v in rows) or 1.0
    noise = next((r for r in rows if "noise" in r[0].lower()), None)
    if noise is None:
        noise = min(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
    rest_lab = next((r[0] for r in rows if r is not noise), "Everything else")
    share = noise[1] / tot

    n = 3
    a0, a1 = 0.06, 0.62
    span = (a1 - a0) / n
    k = int(clamp((u - a0) / span, 0, n - 0.001))
    f = clamp((u - a0 - k * span) / span)
    mv = ease(seg(f, 0.08, 0.72))
    step = 0.0 if u < a0 else (k + mv) / n
    done = u >= a1
    if done:
        step = 1.0
    fill = share * step

    landscape(cr, t, "town")

    # the neighbours: a far skyline of blocks down the street, under haze
    far = [(-40, 150, 520), (130, 300, 620), (700, 860, 560), (850, 1010, 680), (990, 1140, 480)]
    for i, (x0, x1, hh) in enumerate(far):
        fb = building(cr, x0, x1, 1300, hh, [(150, 132, 120), (128, 120, 118), (160, 140, 124)][i % 3],
                      roof="flat", boards=False)
        for r in range(int(hh // 70)):
            for c in range(3):
                cr.rectangle(fb["x0"] + 14 + c * (x1 - x0 - 20) / 3, fb["top"] + 24 + r * 70,
                             (x1 - x0) / 3 - 26, 34)
                cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((84, 92, 108), 0.8))
                cr.fill()
    haze(cr, 500, 1310, (206, 210, 220), a=0.5)

    # the sidewalk and the street running to the camera
    cr.rectangle(0, 1400, W, 110)
    solid(cr, (176, 172, 164), edge=False)
    for i in range(9):
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((130, 126, 120)))
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(i * 140, 1400)
        cr.line_to(i * 140 - 40, 1510)
        cr.stroke()
    cr.rectangle(0, 1500, W, 22)
    solid(cr, (150, 146, 140))
    vgrad(cr, [(0, (70, 72, 78)), (1, (46, 48, 54))], 1522, H)
    for i in range(6):
        cr.rectangle(60 + i * 190, 1700, 110, 14)
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 200, 90)))
        cr.fill()

    # the apartment block: the whole of the city's complaints
    X0, X1, BASE, WH = 200, 720, 1440, 700
    cast_shadow(cr, X0, X1 + 120, BASE, length=340, a=0.32)
    contact_shadow(cr, (X0 + X1) / 2 + 40, BASE + 4, X1 - X0 + 160, a=0.4)
    b = building(cr, X0, X1, BASE, WH, (164, 86, 64), roof="flat", boards=False)
    top, base = b["top"], b["base"]
    fx0, fx1 = b["x0"], b["x1"]
    fw = fx1 - fx0
    hgt = base - top

    # the rooftop water tower — a New York tell
    tx = fx1 - 140
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((60, 48, 40)))
    cr.set_line_width(6)
    for lx in (tx + 8, tx + 38, tx + 72):
        cr.move_to(lx, top)
        cr.line_to(lx, top - 40)
    cr.stroke()
    cylinder(cr, tx, top - 40, 80, 80, (140, 104, 72))
    cr.move_to(tx - 6, top - 118)
    cr.line_to(tx + 40, top - 150)
    cr.line_to(tx + 86, top - 118)
    cr.close_path()
    solid(cr, (96, 76, 60))

    # cornice along the roof line
    cr.rectangle(fx0 - 10, top, fw + 20, 22)
    solid(cr, (206, 196, 180))

    cut = base - (hgt - 22) * fill

    floors, cols = 9, 4
    gx = fw / cols
    gy = (hgt - 60) / floors
    for r in range(floors):
        for c in range(cols):
            wx = fx0 + c * gx + gx * 0.24
            wy = top + 40 + r * gy + gy * 0.16
            ww, wh = gx * 0.52, gy * 0.6
            loud = wy + wh > cut
            if loud:
                glow(cr, wx + ww / 2, wy + wh / 2, ww, (255, 200, 120), 0.55)
            cr.rectangle(wx - 5, wy - 8, ww + 10, 8)          # stone lintel
            solid(cr, (214, 204, 188), rim=False)
            cr.rectangle(wx, wy, ww, wh)
            solid(cr, (255, 214, 140) if loud else (66, 80, 100), finish="glass")
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((236, 230, 220)))
            cr.set_line_width(4)
            cr.move_to(wx, wy + wh / 2)
            cr.line_to(wx + ww, wy + wh / 2)
            cr.stroke()
    # fire escapes zig-zagging down the left two columns
    cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((34, 34, 40)))
    for r in range(floors - 1):
        py = top + 40 + (r + 1) * gy - 4
        ex0, ex1 = fx0 + gx * 0.1, fx0 + gx * 1.9
        cr.set_line_width(7)
        cr.move_to(ex0, py)
        cr.line_to(ex1, py)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_line_width(3)
        cr.move_to(ex0, py - 30)
        cr.line_to(ex1, py - 30)
        for j in range(9):
            xx = ex0 + (ex1 - ex0) * j / 8
            cr.move_to(xx, py)
            cr.line_to(xx, py - 30)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_line_width(5)
        if r % 2 == 0:
            cr.move_to(ex0 + 30, py)
            cr.line_to(ex1 - 40, py + gy)
        else:
            cr.move_to(ex1 - 30, py)
            cr.line_to(ex0 + 40, py + gy)
        cr.stroke()

    # the loudspeaker's position, shoved up the sidewalk to the block
    SY = 1490
    sx = 820 - 200 * step
    SW, SH = 170, 340
    cx, cy = sx, SY - 180
    power = 0.35 + 0.65 * clamp(step * 2.5)

    # THE SOUND washing up the facade: rings of air rolling out of the
    # speaker over the lower floors, only as high as the noise has reached
    if fill > 0.002:
        cr.save()
        cr.rectangle(fx0, cut, fw, base - cut)
        cr.clip()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 244, 220), 0.18))
        cr.rectangle(fx0, cut, fw, base - cut)
        cr.fill()
        for i in range(6):
            r0 = 90 + ((t * 300 + i * 120) % 720)
            a = 0.9 * (1 - (r0 - 90) / 720)
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 26, 24), 0.35 * a))
            cr.set_line_width(24)
            cr.arc(cx, cy, r0, math.pi * 0.55, math.pi * 1.45)
            cr.stroke()
            cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 240, 210), a))
            cr.set_line_width(13)
            cr.arc(cx, cy, r0, math.pi * 0.55, math.pi * 1.45)
            cr.stroke()
        cr.restore()
        # the share in the accent: a bracket down the block's edge, and the line
        cr.rectangle(fx0 - 34, cut, 20, base - cut)
        solid(cr, P["accent2"])
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c(P["accent2"]))
        cr.set_line_width(7)
        cr.move_to(fx0 - 34, cut)
        cr.line_to(fx1 + 20, cut)
        cr.stroke()
        if base - cut > 80:
            text(cr, noise[0].upper(), fx0 + fw * 0.62, cut + 56, 46, look.INK,
                 face="bold", anchor="center")
    la = ease(seg(u, a1 - 0.06, a1))
    if la > 0:
        text(cr, rest_lab.upper(), fx0 + fw / 2, top + hgt * 0.42, 44, look.INK,
             face="bold", anchor="center", alpha=la)

    # the loudspeaker itself, its own waves blasting toward the block
    for i in range(4):
        r0 = 80 + ((t * 260 + i * 150) % 600)
        a = 0.85 * (1 - (r0 - 80) / 600) * power
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((40, 26, 24), 0.35 * a))
        cr.set_line_width(26)
        cr.arc(cx, cy, r0, math.pi * 0.7, math.pi * 1.3)
        cr.stroke()
        cr.set_source_rgba(*_c((255, 236, 200), a))
        cr.set_line_width(16)
        cr.arc(cx, cy, r0, math.pi * 0.7, math.pi * 1.3)
        cr.stroke()
    contact_shadow(cr, sx + SW / 2, SY + 4, SW + 60, a=0.45)
    box(cr, sx, SY, SW, SH, (46, 46, 54), depth=44, finish="gloss")
    for (yy, rr) in ((SY - 250, 50), (SY - 110, 66)):
        disc(cr, sx + SW / 2, yy, rr + 8, (30, 30, 36), finish="matte")
        disc(cr, sx + SW / 2, yy, rr, (84, 84, 96), finish="metal")
        disc(cr, sx + SW / 2, yy, rr * 0.34, (26, 26, 32), finish="gloss")
    for wx in (sx + 26, sx + SW - 26):
        disc(cr, wx, SY - 4, 15, (40, 40, 44), finish="metal")

    # right by the camera: the street's trash cans
    contact_shadow(cr, 125, 1804, 170, a=0.4)
    cylinder(cr, 60, 1800, 130, 170, (96, 110, 96), finish="metal")
    contact_shadow(cr, 950, 1864, 170, a=0.4)
    cylinder(cr, 885, 1860, 130, 160, (88, 100, 90), finish="metal")
    foreground(cr, "town")
    vignette(cr, a=0.28)

    hx, hy = sx + SW + 70, SY
    if u < a0:
        host("point", hx, hy, 230)
    elif u < a1 + 0.04:
        host("shove", hx, hy, 230, beat=k)
    elif u < 0.92:
        host("shove", hx, hy, 230, beat=n)
    else:
        host("shock", hx, hy, 230)

    if done:
        fit_readout(cr, f"{int(round(share * 100))}%",
                    "of all New York City complaints are about noise",
                    80, 520, size=130)
    else:
        fit_readout(cr, "NYC complaints", "everything New Yorkers phone in",
                    80, 520, a=ease(seg(u, 0.0, 0.05)), size=130)
